_comment: A mod's rule files name only what they change. Entries are matched by id: listed fields replace the game's, everything else stays. A new id adds a unit. {"id": "...", "_remove": true} deletes one.

units.name: Veteran Grenadier
units.description: Men who have seen the whole war. Tougher and keener-eyed than a new grenadier, and worth what they cost.
